name: professional-skills
description: Professional writing skills for AI coding agents: anti-slop editing that makes drafts sound human, technical content writing with runtime voice calibration, and a tech-blog-series workflow that researches, drafts, illustrates and reviews long-form technical posts.

interface.shortDescription: Anti-slop editing, technical content writing, and technical blog series
interface.longDescription: Three production-grade writing skills for AI coding agents: anti-slop-writing removes AI tells and restores human voice; technical-content-writer drafts checkable technical posts, threads, and docs in a derived voice; tech-blog-series takes a technical blog post or series from research to a reviewed draft with a fact ledger, hand-built SVG figures, and a review panel.
defaultPrompt: Use Professional Skills to edit this draft so it sounds like a person wrote it.
Use Professional Skills to write a technical LinkedIn post about what I just shipped.
Use Professional Skills to plan and write a technical blog series about our system, with figures and a review pass.
